page.layout: One printed page, rotated on the scan. Running head at top, page number top right of the text block. Main text in one column. Marginal notes to the right of the column (small references). Final line "tum" set at the right edge of the column, below the last full line.

main_text.p: fundamentis. - Imo etiam, vt qui ingenio effent tardiores, per Mathem, studia rederentur acutiores, magisque docites, memores ac solertes. 7. Denique vt à iuuentute sua, patriæ stabiliendæ, exornandæ ac defendendæ studerent: quod quidem omne per dextram Mathematicarum disciplinarum cognitionem illos feliciter assequi posse arbitrabantur, quandoquidem hæ disciplinæ tam pacis tempore, summo essent & ornamento & vtilitati Magi stratui ciuibusque futuræ, quam in belli statu maximæ & vtilitati & necessitati non modo Ducibus sed & militibus. Quandiu enim pace ac tranquillitate in vrbe liceret frui, eas ad mores informandos prodesse plurimum, non minus facere ad felicem rei familiaris gubernationem, maxime vero ad politicam prudentiam & rempublicam administrandam conferre. Quamprimum vero belli necessitas exigeret, statim

page.notes: Marginal references are printed in small italic type beside the text: "7." and "5. de leg. 7. de republ." near the top, "9." at mid-page, and "5. de leg." beside the lower lines. Their exact placement within the lines is approximate. The word "tum" at the foot is the catchword, and "statim" is split across the line end as "sta-/tim" in print.
